title: Segregated client eval channel with config-change triggered safeguards
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and ship a customer-scoped evaluation channel that runs locally or on-customer-dedicated nodes to validate quality regressions and config changes while preserving data isolation and minimizing telemetry. The channel must be triggerable by model/config change events, support configurable failure thresholds, and provide an auditable decision trail for canary/rollback choices.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can opt into a segregated eval channel per deployment (hosted,dedicated,private) with a single toggle and policy settings
Eval runs are triggered automatically on model version or serving-config changes and produce time-series metrics and a pass/fail verdict within SLA (<= 90 minutes for medium suites)
No customer raw prompts or outputs leave the customer boundary for private deployments; only hashed anchors and aggregated metrics are emitted unless explicit opt-in
Rollout rules in Console allow blocking or auto-rollback when per-customer eval failures exceed configured thresholds
Audit logs capture which golden set, model version, and config snapshot produced the failing signal
Integration tests covering a mock private deployment, hosted-dedicated hybrid, and console gating UX land green
deliverables: Eval channel config schema and console toggle
Lightweight local runner binary for private deployments (restricted telemetry)
Server-side orchestrator for hosted/dedicated eval lanes
Console UX: per-customer eval dashboard + rollout block UI
Docs: onboarding guide, data-privacy contract language, runbook for ops
design_notes: Two operating modes: 'local-only' (private/on-prem) where only hashed anchors & aggregated metrics exit boundary, and 'managed' (hosted/dedicated) where raw samples may be processed under customer consent
Trigger model: event-driven from model registry + serving-config webhook; debounce window configurable to avoid noisy re-runs
Golden set handling: allow customers to provide local golden sets (preferred) or select from curated agent-provided suites; support differential hashes for privacy-preserving diffs
Evaluation cost controls: sample size policies (quick/medium/exhaustive) with estimated runtime/cost shown in Console prior to run
Failure policy: 'soft' alerting vs 'hard' block; allow A/B lanes for partial rollouts after failing signal
decisions: Default opt-in is OFF for private deployments; customers must enable either via Console toggle or Infrastructure-as-Code flag
Telemetry emitted from private deployments will be limited to SHA-256 anchors, aggregated scalar metrics, and a run-id; no raw text by default
Quick-run suites will be the default for automated triggers to reduce cost and latency; full suites available on-demand
Console will expose both absolute delta thresholds and relative-percentage regression thresholds for customizable gating
